description: Compile-only (V1) check for the two order-inquiry screen pairs: D0604A/F0604A (06-04, new screen porting R0408A's CHAIN(TOKUIM)+READ(JUCHUM) logic) and D0610A/F0610A (06-10, the same screen using INDDS instead of numbered *IN03). No CALL steps: both are WORKSTN/EXFMT programs, and per 04-11's own established hardware finding (docs/part04/04-11-display-file-inquiry.md), an interactive WORKSTN program hangs when CALLed over non-interactive SSH (no real 5250 device to satisfy EXFMT's read). Interactive behavior (V3) is left to a learner's real 5250 session. QRPGLESRC/QDDSSRC are assumed to already exist by this point (created by part06-0103-freeform / TXSETUP respectively) but ensureSrcFile is included defensively in case this batch runs first.
